    (x : BitInput (BitLoc ℓ r C.size κ)) (i : Column ℓ) : Prop :=

  ∃ hdef : ∀ h, promised f (readA x i h),
    (∀ h, readTranscript x i (trueAddress f x i hdef) h =
      circuitEval C (readA x i h)) ∧
    constructionOutwardPointers x i (trueAddress f x i hdef)
